features.title: Sign up with email and password
acceptance: Open /sign-up while signed out
Enter a new unique email and a password of at least 6 characters, click Sign up
Land on /books signed in, with the header showing a Sign out button
Open /sign-up again and sign up with the same email: an error shows next to the form and no account is created
Submit with an empty email or a 5-character password: a validation error shows next to that field

features.title: Sign in and sign out from the header
acceptance: Sign up a new account, then click Sign out in the header: land on /sign-in
On /sign-in enter that email with a wrong password, click Sign in: see 'Invalid email or password' and stay on /sign-in
Enter the right password, click Sign in: land on /books with Sign out in the header
/sign-in links to /sign-up and /sign-up links to /sign-in

features.title: Signed-out visitors are sent to sign in
acceptance: While signed out, open /books: end up on /sign-in
Sign in from there: land on /books
While signed out, open / : end up on /sign-in; while signed in, open / : end up on /books

features.title: Empty shelf on /books
acceptance: Sign up a new account and open /books
See the heading 'My books', one sentence saying the shelf is empty, and an 'Add book' button
Click 'Add book': land on /books/new

features.title: Add a book
acceptance: Signed in, open /books/new: see Title, Author and Status fields; Status shows 'Want to read' by default
Enter title 'Middlemarch' and author 'George Eliot', leave Status, click Save
Land on /books and see 'Middlemarch' by 'George Eliot' with a 'Want to read' badge; the empty state is gone
Add another book choosing Status 'Reading': it shows a 'Reading' badge

features.title: Add-book validation errors next to the field
acceptance: On /books/new click Save with Title and Author empty: 'Title is required' shows next to Title and 'Author is required' next to Author, and no book is added
Enter a 201-character title: an error next to Title says it must be at most 200 characters
Enter a 121-character author: an error next to Author says it must be at most 120 characters
Fix both and Save: the book is added and shows on /books

features.title: Book list newest first with status badges
acceptance: Sign up a new account, add 'First Book' (Want to read), then 'Second Book' (Reading), then 'Third Book' (Finished)
On /books the order is Third Book, Second Book, First Book
Each row shows the title in the serif font, the author, and its badge: Finished, Reading, Want to read
At phone width (390px) the list is a single column with no horizontal scroll

features.title: I only see my own books
acceptance: Sign up account A and add a book with a unique title
Sign out, sign up account B, open /books: B sees the empty state and not A's book
Sign out, sign in as A: A's book is still listed

features.title: Book page at /books/<id>
acceptance: Signed in with one book, click its title on /books: land on /books/<id>
See the title as the page heading, the author, the status badge and a 'Back to my books' link
Click 'Back to my books': return to /books

features.title: Change a book's status; finishing records today's date
acceptance: On a 'Want to read' book's page, change Status to 'Reading' and save: the badge shows Reading, also on /books after reload
Change Status to 'Finished' and save: the page shows 'Finished on <today's date>'
Change Status back to 'Reading': the finish date is no longer shown

features.title: Rate a finished book 1 to 5 stars
acceptance: On a 'Reading' book's page there is no rating control
Mark it Finished: a 5-star rating control appears
Choose 4 stars and save: after reload the page shows 4 of 5 stars selected
Change to 2 stars and save: after reload it shows 2 of 5

features.title: Write a short review of a finished book
acceptance: On a 'Finished' book's page, type a review 'Loved the ending.' and save: after reload the review text is shown
Enter 2,001 characters and save: an error next to the review field says it must be at most 2,000 characters and the old review is kept
On a 'Want to read' book's page there is no review field

features.title: Filter the list by status with tabs kept in the URL
acceptance: Add one book of each status, open /books: tabs All, Want to read, Reading, Finished; All is selected and all three books show
Click 'Reading': the URL becomes /books?status=reading and only the Reading book shows
Reload the page: the Reading tab is still selected with the same single book
Open /books?status=finished directly: only the Finished book shows; click All: the URL is /books and all books show
A tab with no books shows a short 'No books here' message

features.title: Delete a book after confirming
acceptance: On a book's page click Delete: a dialog asks to confirm
Click Cancel: the dialog closes and the book is still there
Click Delete again and confirm: land on /books and the book is no longer listed, also after reload

features.title: Stats page: finished this year and average rating
acceptance: Sign up a new account and open /stats: see 'Books finished this year: 0' and 'Average rating: No ratings yet'
Finish two books today and rate them 4 and 5 stars, finish a third without a rating
Open /stats: see 'Books finished this year: 3' and 'Average rating: 4.5'
The header links to /stats and back to /books

features.title: Book not found page for missing or other users' books
acceptance: As account A add a book and note its /books/<id> URL
Sign out, sign in as account B and open that URL: see a 'Book not found' page with a link back to /books, served with HTTP status 404
Open /books/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000: the same 'Book not found' page with status 404

features.title: Fix: signed-in user sees the sign-in or sign-up form instead of their books
acceptance: Sign up a new account: land on /books with Sign out in the header
While signed in, open /sign-in: end up on /books, not the sign-in form
While signed in, open /sign-up: end up on /books, not the sign-up form
Click Sign out, then open /sign-in and /sign-up: each still shows its form

features.title: Edit a book's title and author from its page

Click Cancel: the fields close and the page still shows 'Midlemarch'

Open /books: the list shows 'Middlemarch' by 'George Eliot' and no longer 'Midlemarch'

features.title: Edit-book validation errors next to the field
acceptance: On a book's page click Edit, clear Title and Author, click Save: 'Title is required' shows next to Title and 'Author is required' next to Author
Enter a 201-character title: an error next to Title says it must be at most 200 characters
Enter a 121-character author: an error next to Author says it must be at most 120 characters
Reload the page: the book still has its old title and author
Fix both and Save: the page and /books show the new values

features.title: Search my shelf by title or author, kept in the URL
acceptance: Sign up a new account and add 'Middlemarch' by 'George Eliot' (Finished), 'Silas Marner' by 'George Eliot' (Reading) and 'Emma' by 'Jane Austen' (Reading)
On /books type 'ELIO' in the search field and submit: the URL becomes /books?q=ELIO and only Middlemarch and Silas Marner show
Search 'march': only Middlemarch shows
Search 'eliot', then click the Reading tab: the URL keeps q=eliot with status=reading and only Silas Marner shows
Reload the page: the search field still shows 'eliot', the Reading tab is selected and only Silas Marner shows
Clear the search field and submit: the URL has no q and all Reading books show

features.title: Search with no matches offers to clear the search
acceptance: Signed in with at least one book, open /books?q=zzzz: one sentence says no books match 'zzzz' and a 'Clear search' link shows
Click 'Clear search': the URL is /books and all books show
Open /books?status=reading&q=zzzz and click 'Clear search': the URL is /books?status=reading and the Reading tab stays selected

features.title: Sort the list by newest, title or rating, kept in the URL
acceptance: Sign up a new account and add, in this order, 'Bravo' (Finished, rated 3), 'Alpha' (Finished, rated 5), 'Charlie' (Finished, no rating), 'Delta' (Reading)
Open /books: the sort control shows 'Newest added' and the order is Delta, Charlie, Alpha, Bravo
Choose 'Title A to Z': the URL has sort=title and the order is Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta
Choose 'Highest rated': the URL has sort=rating and the order is Alpha, Bravo, then the unrated Delta and Charlie last
Click the Finished tab: the URL keeps sort=rating and the order is Alpha, Bravo, Charlie; reload keeps the tab, the sort and the order
Search 'a' with sort=rating: the URL keeps both q and sort, and the results are in rating order

features.title: Set a reading goal for this year on Stats
acceptance: Sign up a new account and open /stats: a sentence invites me to set a reading goal for this year, with a number field and a 'Set goal' button
Finish one book today, then on /stats enter 20 and click 'Set goal': see '1 of 20 books finished this year' and a progress bar at 5%
Reload /stats: the goal and progress are still shown
Enter 0, then 366, then 2.5 and submit each: an error next to the field says the goal must be a whole number from 1 to 365, and no goal is saved

features.title: Change this year's reading goal
acceptance: With a goal of 20 and one book finished this year, on /stats click 'Change goal': the number field shows 20
Enter 10 and save: see '1 of 10 books finished this year' and the progress bar at 10%, also after reload
Click 'Change goal', enter 366 and save: an error next to the field says the goal must be a whole number from 1 to 365, and after reload the goal is still 10

features.title: Fix: after moving between pages, hidden earlier pages leave duplicate main regions, field ids and doubled field names
acceptance: In a fresh browser open /sign-up, sign up a new account and land on /books: the document has exactly one <main> element

Click Sign out and land on /sign-in: the document has exactly one <main>, one element with id="email" and one with id="password", and the accessibility tree names the fields 'Email' and 'Password' (not 'Email Email')

Sign in, click Add book, add 'Midlemarch' by 'George Eliot', then click it in the list to open /books/<id> without reloading: the document has one <main> and one element with id="status", and the status combobox is named 'Status', not 'Status Status'
Click Edit: the fields are named 'Title' and 'Author', not 'Title Title' and 'Author Author', and there is one element each with id="title" and id="author"
Click the browser Back button to /books and then Forward to the book page: the page still shows 'Midlemarch' and the counts above still hold

features.title: Fix: with the edit form open, a book page has two buttons both named 'Save', so a screen reader user cannot tell them apart
acceptance: Signed in, add 'Midlemarch' by 'George Eliot' and open its page /books/<id>
Click Edit: the Title and Author fields appear, and no two buttons on the page have the same accessible name

The button that saves title and author and the button that saves the status each have an accessible name that says what it saves (for example 'Save title and author' and 'Save status'), not just 'Save'
Change the title to 'Middlemarch' and click the title-and-author save button: the heading shows 'Middlemarch' and the status is unchanged
Pick 'Reading' in Status and click the status save button: the page shows 'Reading', also after reload

features.title: Fix: once 'Change goal' is open on Stats there is no way to close it without saving or reloading
acceptance: Signed in with a reading goal of 20, open /stats: see '0 of 20 books finished this year' and a 'Change goal' button
Click 'Change goal': the Reading goal field shows 20, and next to 'Save goal' there is a 'Cancel' button
Enter 5 in the field and click 'Cancel': the form closes without saving, the page still shows '0 of 20 books finished this year' and the 'Change goal' button is back
Click 'Change goal' again: the field shows 20, not 5
Reload the page: it still shows '0 of 20 books finished this year'

features.title: Shelves page: make a named shelf
acceptance: Sign up a new account: the header has a 'Shelves' link; click it and land on /shelves, where one sentence says I have no shelves yet, with a Name field and a 'Create shelf' button

Sign out, sign up a second account and open /shelves: it shows no shelves

features.title: Shelf name validation: required, at most 40 characters, unique
acceptance: On /shelves click 'Create shelf' with an empty name: 'Name is required' shows next to the field and no shelf is created
Enter a 41-character name: an error next to the field says it must be at most 40 characters, and no shelf is created
Create 'Travel', then try to create 'travel' (any case, with spaces around it): an error next to the field says I already have a shelf with that name, and the list still has one 'Travel'
A second account can create its own 'Travel' shelf without an error

features.title: Rename a shelf on /shelves
acceptance: With shelves 'Travel' and 'Book club', click 'Rename' next to 'Travel': a Name field shows prefilled with 'Travel', with Save and Cancel buttons

Rename 'Trips' to 'book club': an error next to the field says I already have a shelf with that name; after reload the shelf is still 'Trips'
Rename 'Trips' to an empty name: 'Name is required' shows next to the field
Click 'Rename', change the name, then click 'Cancel': the form closes and the name is unchanged

features.title: Put a book on my shelves from its page, which lists its shelves

features.title: Take a book off a shelf
acceptance: With 'Middlemarch' on 'Travel' and 'Book club', on its page click the remove button next to 'Travel' (named 'Remove from Travel'): only 'Book club' is listed, also after reload

features.title: Delete a shelf after confirming, keeping its books
acceptance: With 'Middlemarch' on 'Travel', on /shelves click 'Delete' next to 'Travel': a confirm dialog names the shelf and says its books are kept
Click Cancel: 'Travel' is still listed
Click 'Delete' again and confirm: 'Travel' is gone from /shelves, also after reload
Open /books: 'Middlemarch' is still there; its page lists no 'Travel' shelf

features.title: Filter the list by shelf, kept in the URL with tab, search and sort
acceptance: Sign up a new account, add 'Alpha' (Reading), 'Bravo' (Finished), 'Charlie' (Reading), make a 'Travel' shelf and put Alpha and Bravo on it

features.title: Record reading progress on a book I am reading

features.title: Progress validation errors next to the field

features.title: The list shows reading progress with a small progress bar

features.title: Finishing a book sets its page to the total

features.title: Status tabs show how many books each has

features.title: Write notes on a book from its page, newest first with their date

features.title: Delete a note after confirming

features.title: Save quotes from a book on its page, with an optional page number

Click 'Edit', change the text, then click 'Cancel': the form closes and the quote is unchanged

features.title: Delete a quote after confirming
acceptance: With two quotes on a book, click 'Delete' next to one: a confirm dialog asks whether to delete the quote

Click 'Delete' again and confirm: that quote is gone, also after reload, and the other quote and the book are still there

features.title: Quotes page lists all my quotes newest first, linking to their books

features.title: Search my quotes by text or book title, kept in the URL

features.title: No one else can see or change my notes and quotes

features.title: Moving a book to Reading records today's start date

features.title: The book page shows when I started and finished it and how many days I read it

features.title: Read a finished book again, keeping the earlier read

A tag longer than 24 characters shows 'Tags are at most 24 characters'
Adding 'Classic' to a book that has 'classic' shows 'This book already has that tag' (case does not matter)
On a book with 10 tags, adding an 11th shows 'A book has at most 10 tags'

features.title: Filter the list by tag, kept in the URL with tab, search, sort and shelf
acceptance: The list has a 'Tag' select with 'All tags' and each of my tags A to Z
Choosing 'classic' shows only books tagged 'classic' and puts ?tag=classic in the URL; reload keeps it
The tag filter combines with the status tab, search, sort and shelf filter, all kept in the URL
A tag with no books in the current tab shows the empty message with a 'Show all tags' link that clears only the tag

features.title: Tags page lists my tags with their book counts, and renames a tag
acceptance: The header has a 'Tags' link to /tags
/tags lists my tags A to Z, each with how many books have it ('1 book', '3 books'), linking to /books?tag=<name>
Renaming 'classic' to 'classics' changes it on every book; a name another of my tags has shows 'You already have that tag'
With no tags, /tags says 'No tags yet' and that tags are added from a book's page

features.title: Export my library as a CSV file
acceptance: The header has an 'Import / export' link to /library
On /library, 'Download CSV' downloads bookshelf.csv whose first row is title,author,status,rating,total_pages,started_on,finished_on
Each of my books is one row with its values; an empty value is an empty cell; a title with a comma or a double quote is quoted correctly
Another account's books never appear in my file

features.title: Import books from a CSV file, with a preview before adding
acceptance: /library has an 'Import CSV' file field; choosing a file in the export format shows a preview table of the rows to add, with 'Add N books' and 'Cancel'
'Add N books' adds them with their status, rating, pages and dates, and the list shows them; 'Cancel' adds nothing
Exporting from one account and importing that file into a new account gives a list with the same titles, statuses and ratings
A file over 1 MB or with more than 1,000 rows is refused with 'The file is too large' before any preview

features.title: Import report: which rows are skipped and why
acceptance: Rows without a title, with an unknown status or a rating outside 1 to 5 are not in the preview; a note says 'N rows will be skipped' and lists each row number with why
A row with the same title and author as a book I have is skipped as 'Already on your shelf'
After 'Add N books', a message says 'Added N books, skipped M'

features.title: Up next: a queue of books I want to read, in my order
acceptance: A Want to read book's page has 'Add to Up next'; a Reading or Finished book's page does not
The header has an 'Up next' link to /up-next, which lists my queued books in order, each with 'Move up', 'Move down' and 'Remove'; the order is kept after reload
A newly queued book goes to the end; the first book has no 'Move up' and the last has no 'Move down'
A book that leaves Want to read leaves the queue

features.title: Start reading the first book in Up next
acceptance: /up-next shows 'Start reading <title>' for the first book
Clicking it moves that book to Reading with today's start date and takes it off the queue; the next book is now first
With an empty queue, /up-next says 'Nothing up next' and links to the Want to read tab

features.title: Settings: a display name shown in the header
acceptance: The header has a 'Settings' link to /settings
Saving the display name 'Huy' shows 'Huy' in the header before 'Sign out', also after reload
An empty name shows 'Enter a name'; a name over 40 characters shows 'Names are at most 40 characters'
Without a display name the header shows no name

features.title: Delete my account after typing DELETE, with all my data
acceptance: /settings has 'Delete account'; it opens a dialog where 'Delete my account' stays disabled until DELETE is typed
Confirming deletes the account with all its books, shelves, notes, quotes, reads, tags and queue, signs out and shows the sign in page with 'Your account was deleted'
Signing in again with the same email and password fails
Another account's books and data are unchanged

features.title: No one else can see or change my tags, queue, display name or imported books
acceptance: Account A tags a book 'classic', queues two books, sets a display name and imports a CSV; account B sees 'No tags yet' on /tags, 'Nothing up next' on /up-next, none of A's books on /books or /books?tag=classic, and no name in the header
With B's session against the local Supabase, reading, updating or deleting A's tags, queue rows or profile by id returns or changes no rows (an integration test the verifier runs)
Signed in again as A, A's tags, queue, name and books are unchanged

features.title: Fix: the tagged book list's screenshot (F064's spec) changes from run to run on CI
acceptance: e2e/F064-tags-book.spec.ts masks each book's whole row or card in its list screenshot, a block whose size does not change from run to run, instead of the title link text whose width follows its Date.now() suffix
Every assertion and the full-page screenshot of the spec stay as they are; only the masks and the regenerated baseline F064-list-tags.png change
The spec passes 5 runs in a row in Playwright's Docker browser (scripts/e2e.sh e2e/F064-tags-book.spec.ts --repeat-each=5) with no pixel difference

features.title: Fix: /books/<not a uuid> returns 500 instead of the book not found page since tags
acceptance: Signed in, opening /books/not-a-uuid shows the book not found page with HTTP 404, as before tags (decision 0002), not a 500
listBookTags and every other tag query that takes a book id return nothing for an id that is not a UUID, with the isUuid guard lib/notes.ts, quotes.ts, reads.ts and queue.ts already use
A new e2e spec checks the 404 for /books/not-a-uuid; no existing spec changes

features.title: Fix: e2e screenshots show today's date unmasked, so every run after the baseline's day fails
acceptance: Every e2e screenshot masks each date that comes from the day the test runs (for example 'Started on <date>', 'Finished on <date>', 'Read in N days'), with a mask over the block the date sits in, so the baselines pass on any later day; e2e/F064-tags-book.spec.ts ('book page: add and remove tags') and e2e/F065-tag-validation.spec.ts ('an 11th tag is rejected') first
Only masks and the baselines they change are touched: every assertion, step and screenshot stays
Each changed spec passes in Playwright's Docker browser (scripts/e2e.sh <spec>), and CI's e2e shards pass on the PR

features.title: Look up a book by ISBN or title and fill the add form
acceptance: The add form has a 'Look up' field and button; an ISBN or a title fills title, author and total pages, which can still be edited before saving
The lookup goes through our server route, never from the browser to Open Library; the route answers from a fixture when BOOK_LOOKUP_FIXTURE is set, and every test and the verifier use the fixture
Looking up the same ISBN twice within a day calls Open Library once (a unit test with a fake fetch)

features.title: Lookup failures: timeout, nothing found or refused keep the form usable
acceptance: When Open Library takes over 5 s, the form says 'Lookup timed out, enter the book by hand' and the fields stay editable
When nothing is found it says 'No book found for <query>'; when the service refuses (429 or 5xx) it says 'Lookup is not available right now'
In each case 'Add book' still saves a book typed by hand

features.title: Upload, replace or remove a book's cover image
acceptance: A book's page has 'Add cover'; a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB uploads and shows on the page; 'Replace cover' and 'Remove cover' work and survive a reload
A file over 2 MB or of another type is refused with 'Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 2 MB' and nothing is stored
Covers are in a private bucket: storage policies let only the owner read, write or delete their book's cover (an integration test with a second account)
Deleting the book or the account deletes its cover file

features.title: Covers on the list and the book page, with a placeholder
acceptance: The list shows each book's cover as a small thumbnail, or a placeholder with the title's first letter when it has none
Covers load through short-lived signed URLs, never a public URL; the page has no layout shift when a cover loads (the thumbnail has a fixed size)

features.title: Share a shelf by link, read-only, without signing in
acceptance: Each shelf on /shelves has 'Share'; it makes a link /s/<token> (an unguessable token) and 'Copy link'
Signed out, /s/<token> shows the shelf's name and its books with title, author, status, rating and cover, read-only, with no header links to my pages
'Stop sharing' makes the old link show the not found page; sharing again makes a new token
Anonymous access goes through one security definer function or view that returns only the shared shelf's allowed columns; RLS on books, notes, quotes, reviews and tags is unchanged

features.title: A shared shelf shows nothing private
acceptance: A shared page never shows notes, quotes, reviews, tags, other shelves, the owner's email or display name

With the anon key against the local Supabase, the share function returns nothing for a wrong or revoked token, and no anon query can read books, notes, quotes or covers outside a shared shelf (an integration test the verifier runs)

features.title: The list loads 20 books at a time with 'Load more'
acceptance: With 45 books the list shows 20, 'Load more' shows 40, then 45 and the button goes away
Paging keeps the tab, search, sort, shelf and tag filters, and the counts in the tabs are unchanged
A book added while paged in still shows once, not twice

features.title: The list updates live when my books change in another tab
acceptance: With /books open in two tabs, a book added in one shows in the other within 5 seconds without a reload; a status change and a delete show too
Only my own books come through: a second account's changes never reach my tab (Realtime with RLS)
When the connection drops and comes back, the list catches up

features.title: No one else can read my covers, or shelves I did not share
acceptance: Account B cannot open A's cover by its storage path or a stale signed URL, cannot see A's books through Realtime, and /s/<made-up token> is not found
After A stops sharing, B and a signed-out visitor both get not found on the old link
